title: Language and Cultural Rights
description: Understanding Nepal's constitutional provisions for language rights and cultural preservation.

sections.title: Recognition of Diversity
sections.content: Nepal is linguistically and culturally diverse. Constitutional provisions recognize multiple languages and protect cultural heritage, rituals, and traditional knowledge systems.

sections.title: Official and Local Language Use
sections.content: While certain languages function in federal administration, provinces and local governments may adopt additional languages for official purposes, promoting inclusion and accessibility.

sections.title: Cultural Preservation and Promotion
sections.content: Policies encourage documentation, education, and transmission of cultural practices. Museums, cultural centers, and festivals help sustain identity while fostering inter-community respect.

sections.title: Challenges in a Globalizing Era
sections.content: Urbanization, migration, and digital media can pressure smaller language communities. Strategic revitalization programs and inclusive curricula mitigate loss and marginalization.

summary: Nepal protects linguistic and cultural diversity
Local bodies can adopt working languages
Cultural preservation uses policy and institutions
